message_hierarchy.company_promise: Help an established business pursue roughly 2x the output at half the operating cost, one workflow at a time.
message_hierarchy.rule: Choose one topic-specific idea per video. Every title, scene, narration line, and CTA must support it and connect naturally to the company promise without repeating the same headline mechanically.
message_hierarchy.scenario_b_topic: Disconnected AI tools need one operating system before they can work as a team.
message_hierarchy.scenario_c_topic: A real AI department is built by defining roles, context, standards, and workflows.

voice_direction: Synthesize the spoken transcript only. A deep, grounded adult male narrator with restrained confidence and a warm humanistic cadence. Speak at a natural conversational pace — flowing, not rushed, no dead air — and land the final URL clearly.
quality_gates: The video communicates one topic-specific idea connected to the company promise.
Every clip in BOTH scenarios uses the exact same pinned prebuilt voice (voice_selection) — no mixed generations or auditions.
Each line plays in full: scene timing is derived from measured spoken clip durations, never from fixed windows that trim mid-sentence.
Each line earns a visual change; no narration merely restates on-screen copy.
The final audio is narration-only: no music bed in the mix or in the spec.
The spoken URL is human-readable, not read as punctuation.
The final file contains both video and audio streams.
Final mix is checked on headphones and phone speaker.
